svg.title: moon_laundromat floor plan
svg.text: Plan in metres, north up. Narrow self-service laundromat on a quiet side street off Poeun-ro, Mangwon-dong (Mangwon 1-dong), Mapo-gu. Fictional, no real address.
7–8 minutes' walk from Taeo's flat, about 13 from Hanbit Mart. Drawn to the Codex key world/keys/moon_laundromat/ and scripts/ch005.yaml.
QUIET SIDE STREET OFF POEUN-RO (E–W), MANGWON-DONG
pavement · sodium lamps · every other shutter down at night
